edits.current: Browser contexts check the same refinements. With the browser engines installed, `LEAN_BRIDGE_LAKE_WASM_TEST=1 LEAN_BRIDGE_TYPE_CORPUS_BROWSERS=chromium,firefox,webkit node --test tests/browser-refinements.test.mjs` builds an ordinary-source package whose exports carry a `Fin 10` alias, `Fin` inside nested arrays, an empty `Fin 0` array, a bound above 64 bits, `Fin` inside `List (Option (pair × Except))` and two checked Subtypes; reproduces it from two clean roots; installs it offline; bundles a plain page, a React page in strict and production modes and a dedicated worker with Vite; and runs the shared check script in each engine. Every context must report exactly the pinned numbers of passed checks and package rejections, rerun to the same result, request no foreign origin and load the Wasm asset from the served bundle. The report lands at `build/browser-refinements/report.json`.
